notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with power one or greater.
description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
